purpose: Game lore and interactive narrative through versioned evidence, player agency, design craft, community interpretation, and access.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Distinguish released canon, creator comment, and fan theory by version. Credit creators and communities, respect rights, and test whether accessibility options expose the story.
